finalText:
I read the board on `ui/GitPanel.tsx` and changed nothing. It has 236 stickies, grouped into six sections plus 60 loose stickies below them. Each loose sticky repeats one already in a section, so I counted it with that section's theme. Most stickies are copies of about ten points per theme, marked with "+1 Name", so the counts work like votes.

| # | Theme | Stickies | In section + loose | Points that come up most |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Onboarding** | **60** | 40 + 20 | sign-in loops twice, unclear what a project is, GitHub step asks for too much, tour starts before the canvas loads (each 6×) |
| 2 | **Export** | **56** | 36 + 20 | PDF loses fonts, want JPG, exporting 40 artboards is slow, print PDF needs bleed, export dialog hides the scope (each 6×) |
| 3 | **Performance** | **50** | 40 + 10 | slow with 30 artboards, zoom stutters, big canvas takes 8 s to open, inspector typing lags (each 5×) |
| 4 | **Pricing** | **41** | 31 + 10 | annual toggle is confusing, team plan feels high, per-seat vs per-project unclear (each 4×). One sticky here is locked: "keep the student tier — decided with Tereza" |
| 5 | **Done** (already shipped) | **24** | 24 + 0 | fixed the double sign-in, added JPG export, faster thumbnails |

Notes:
- **Done isn't really a feedback theme.** It lists work that's already finished. Leave it out and the fifth theme is **Ideas**, with **5** stickies (poster set, match recap, logo sting, sponsor wall, volunteer page).
- **Some complaints may already be fixed.** "Sign-in loops twice" and "want JPG" each still appear 6 times, but Done lists both fixes. Those stickies may be out of date.
- The board also has a pricing vote that's still open. I didn't look at who voted.

I tried to tally the stickies with a short script, but it needed approval and nobody was there to give it, so it was blocked. I counted by reading the board's data directly instead. The totals add up to all 236 stickies.
